load_camera_poses: load camera poses from a JSON file and return image paths, intrinsics, extrinsics, and timestamps
save_camera_poses: save camera poses to a JSON file with image paths, intrinsics, extrinsics, and timestamps
generate_video: generate a video from image frames using ffmpeg with configurable codec, fps, and quality settings
numpy_to_video: convert a numpy array of shape T,H,W,C into a video file using ffmpeg
video_to_numpy: convert a video file into a numpy array of shape T,H,W,C using ffmpeg
